Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavita - 37 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Tanay - 10 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
4. Zoya - 8 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Kavya - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Kavita and Zoya stand near him.]

Zoya: "What lovely weather!"

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ayaan: "Exactly right."

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Kavita (excited): "One more time!"

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Kavita: "Careful!"

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Zoya: "What happened?"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ayaan: "What happened?"

[Ayaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Ayaan: "Okay, Zoya."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Ayaan stands in the park. Kavita, Zoya and Kavya stand near him.]

Kavya: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan plays cricket in the park.]

Ayaan (excited): "Zoya, are you okay?"

[Ayaan swings on the swing.]

Ayaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita, Tanay and Zoya stand near him.]

Kavita: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan slips and falls.]

Kavita (happily): "How beautiful!"

[Ayaan trips over a stone.]

Ayaan: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan hurts his knee.]

Kavita (softly): "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan helps Mother get up.]

Tanay (laughing): "Ayaan, are you okay?"

[Ayaan sneezes loudly.]

Ayaan (laughing): "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan coughs.]

Tanay: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 4: The kitchen - Day

Ayaan: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan makes tea for everyone.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Okay, Mom."

[Ayaan chops onions for the curry.]

Ayaan (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ayaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Ayaan: "I really enjoyed today."
